## Write a Custom Distribution

- `RTMB` doesn't have the distribution you want
- Still want their simulation functionality
- Example Poisson-Gamma Mixture with repeated counts within the mixture

```{r}
#| echo: true

## Random generator with a single rate
rpoisgamma <- function(n, size, prob){
  lambda <- rgamma(1, size, prob/(1-prob))
  return(rpois(n, lambda))
}
size = 5
prob = 0.25
x <- rpoisgamma(10, size, prob)

## Distribution
dpoisgamma <- function(x, size, prob, log = FALSE){
  df <- function(theta){
    -sum(dpois(x, exp(theta), log = TRUE)) - 
        dgamma(exp(theta), size, prob/(1-prob), log = TRUE) - theta
  }
  tape <- MakeTape(df, 0)
  dapprox <- tape$laplace(1)
  negprob <- dapprox(numeric(0))
  if(log) return(-negprob)
  return(exp(-negprob))
}

negll <- function(pars){
  getAll(pars)
  r <- exp(logr)
  p <- plogis(logitp)
  
  ll <- 0
  for(i in 1:nrow(x)){
    ll <- ll + sum(dpoisgamma(x[i,], size = r, prob = p, log = TRUE))
  }
  -ll
}
x <- NULL
for( i in 1:10) x <- rbind(x, rpoisgamma(n = 10, size = 3, prob = 0.25))

obj <- MakeADFun(negll, list(logr=0,logitp=0))
fit <- nlminb(obj$par, obj$fn, obj$gr)

negll2 <- function(pars){
  getAll(pars)
  r <- exp(logr)
  p <- plogis(logitp)
  lambda <- exp(re)
  ll <- sum(dgamma(re, r, p/(1-p), log = TRUE) + re)
  for(i in 1:nrow(x)){
    ll <- ll + sum(dpois(x[i,], lambda[i], log = TRUE))
  }
  -ll
}
obj2 <- MakeADFun(negll2, list(logr=0,logitp=0, re = numeric(nrow(x))), random = "re", silent = TRUE)

```
